children: Grayscale named DATA Network (DATA), USD.AI (CHIP) and Pearl (PEARL) as cryptocurrencies targeting AI infrastructure, from training-data licensing to GPU finance and computing. In an October 23 research note, Head of Research Zach Pandl said their long-term relevance depends on adoption and competitive economics, according to BeInCrypto. DATA fell 42.07% in 90 days to $0.15243; the Sui Foundation announced a $30 million investment. CHIP rose 47.98% in 90 days to $0.04386 after Bullish announced a $100 million GPU-loan facility. PEARL surged 528.24% in 90 days to $2.00, but estimated daily issuance of 1.2 million tokens and a $4.2 billion fully diluted valuation versus a $713 million market cap pose risks.

title: Grayscale Names 3 Cryptocurrencies That Could Benefit From AI Growth
